title: Cloud Controller 2.6.0
summary: Sign-in with your portal identity, a new Access screen, change password in the user menu and a categorized menu.

items.title: Sign in with your portal e-mail
items.body: The controller sign-in uses the e-mail and password of your Nexwall Partner Portal user (role Controller Admin or Controller User). Two-step verification, when enabled, is the portal's. Forgot password sends a code to your e-mail and then asks for a new password.

items.title: Access screen
items.body: Users are created in the partner portal. The Access screen lists them with a Firewall groups button, the main control: it sets which groups of firewalls each user can manage. Administrators can also send a new temporary password to a user.

items.title: Change password
items.body: Change password moved to the user menu in the top right. A code is sent to your e-mail, then you choose a new password.

items.title: Serial column
items.body: The Firewalls list shows the serial of each firewall in its own column, and the filter also finds firewalls by serial.

items.title: Categorized menu
items.body: The menu is organized in sections like the portal: Firewalls management, Insights, Access and Help.

items.title: No firewall limit
items.body: Controllers created by a partner no longer show or apply the three-firewall limit.

items.title: Local user management
items.body: Add user, delete user, administrator switch, the Account settings page, the controller's own two-step verification and the SSH keys card were removed: identities belong to the portal and the firewalls use a managed key.
